FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 180
Committee: Agriculture and Forestry Sponsor: Representative Jennifer Fidler
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 03/29/2023
House Bill 180 as introduced will decrease receipts to the Agricultural Fund by an estimated
$20,000 annually due to changing the maximum amount of administrative costs the
Commissioner of Agriculture and Industries may deduct from the assessment on the sale of nuts,
bulbs, fruits, and vegetables from 5% (under current law) to 3%.
